messages:
Lina: Quick thread to finalize the webinar social plan. Need: 1) X teaser + event thread, 2) LinkedIn long post + follow-up, 3) 3 headline variants for the benchmark post, 4) lead routing map. Can we finalize by EOD?
Carlos: Ill own the X thread structure and timing. Plan: day-before teaser (AM PT), live-thread during webinar (every 5-10 mins), post-event highlights thread (30m after).
Priya: LinkedIn plan: single long-form post next day + 2 follow-ups (exec quote, signup CTA). Use the long post for the benchmark narrative: product outcome + one stat.
Evan: For headlines 1: product-first ("Build faster, ship cheaper with predictable inference"); #2: metric-led ("Cut token cost by 3x while keeping latency"); #3: customer story ("How Acme scaled chat w/o latency spikes"). Thoughts?
Lina: Love the set. Pick #1 for organic, #2 for paid creatives. #3 as a testimonial card.
Carlos: Asset list: hero slide (webinar title + CTA), 4 social cards (teaser, stat, testimonial, CTA), GIF snippet of demo clip (~8s). Who's on design?
Priya: tagging design-bot: need priority high, two variants for hero (clean + bold), PNG + source AI file.
design-bot: Asset request submitted: ticket=DES-4820, priority=high, due=36h.
Evan: Routing: paid traffic -> SDR pool "Webinar-Paid"; organic signups -> nurture flow. HubSpot form=ws_2024_06, webhook=/api/webhooks/ws. Add utm_source={x|linkedin}, utm_campaign=ws_june24, utm_content={v1|v2|v3}.
Priya: Confirming utm_content will be variant id. Ill include mapping table in the copy doc.
Carlos: Engagement ops: on X pin signup link + one reply with testimonial at +15m, reply from product lead at +2h. Use replies to capture DM leads.
Lina: For LinkedIn, ask two execs to comment within 3h of posting. Priya, can you draft the comment prompts?
Priya: Yep. Drafting 2 short exec comments + a 1-line CTA. Dropping in the doc now: https://docs.google.com/... (edited)
Evan: Small QA item: please ensure CTA links include the campaign param and the event slug. Ill run a quick test webhook after design uploads assets.
ops-bot: Scheduler updated: teaser draft created (X) id=tx_9921, schedule=2024-06-11T14:00:00Z; linkedin draft id=ln_4421 schedule=2024-06-12T19:00:00Z
Carlos: I'll queue the live-thread template now and share a sample cadence for copy. Expect in the copy doc ~15m.
Lina: Two micro-testimonials needed for replies (<=70 chars). Evan, can you pull from early beta quotes?
Evan: Pulling 3 options now and pasting in the copy doc.
Priya: One more ask: benchmark social blurb (single-sentence stat + CTA) for cards. I'll add a "social_blurb" field in the doc.
Lina: Great. If design confirms assets within 36h and no legal blocks, we ship teaser tomorrow morning PT. :rocket:
